record.notes: This corrects any reading of Morph as a credit provider: the free tier starts at zero MCUs, so the USD 40 Team tier is a purchase of 1000 MCUs, not a grant. The MCU-to-dollar rate is on a different page and was not read, so this record claims no hourly price; 1000 MCUs at USD 40 would make a Medium runner 5 MCU an hour, i.e. USD 0.20, which is arithmetic on an unverified unit price and is not used in the ranking.
